coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (phase 0) record, coded in full for the translational subset. Single arm with three categories by baseline thyroid function. Methimazole and liothyronine are the investigational thyroid-state intervention (summary states a possible cancer-treatment benefit), so both coded experimental_combination; liothyronine also acts as thyroid hormone maintenance, which could be read as supportive. Lomustine is given in every category as the chemotherapy backbone; its schedule is the standard 6-weekly one (the text also says 'lomustine daily' once), so not coded as an established-therapy experiment. Thyroid hormone levels are correlated with outcomes and are the intended pharmacodynamic effect of methimazole, so coded target engagement yes (blood); not a tumour molecular biomarker.
